lines.line: Poses change instantly. With nothing in between, her head and arms snapped from one to the next.
Now her upper body follows the pose through a critically damped filter. About eighty milliseconds, and it never overshoots.
Her legs skip the filter, so her feet stay exactly planted.
But her back still moved like a plank. So each segment of her spine got its own spring, looser toward the head.
Now her back gives a little when she sets off, stops, or lands in the chair, and then it settles.
